input: Find a local improv or acting class nearby

gold.taskTitle: Find a Local Improv or Acting Class Nearby
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify nearby improv or acting classes that match the user's schedule, budget, and experience level.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should we search in?
questions.description: Determine the user's location or preferred area for finding classes.

questions.title: Are you drawn to improv specifically or general acting?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user has a preference between improv comedy, theatrical acting, screen acting, or is open to either.

questions.title: What is your current experience level with performing?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner, has some experience, or is looking to refine existing skills.

questions.title: What is your budget per class or per month?
questions.description: Establish a price range to filter out options that are too expensive or to prioritize free and low-cost alternatives.

questions.title: Which days and times are you available to attend?
questions.description: Identify the user's weekly availability so class schedules can be matched accordingly.

questions.title: Are you looking for a one-time workshop or ongoing classes?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a short commitment like a single workshop or a recurring weekly course.

questions.title: What is your main goal for taking this class?
questions.description: Understand the underlying motivation, such as building confidence, pursuing performance as a hobby, networking, or professional development.
